title: incident-bot: SLO-toolkit oncall autodiagnostics enhancements and runbook linking improvements
author: Aisha Rao
description: Add enhancements to incident-bot and slo-toolkit utilities to improve oncall autodiagnostics, runbook linking, and contextual helpers. This PR contains three coordinated pieces: 1) incident-bot: add prioritized runbook linking heuristics that include SLO context, error fingerprinting, and recent deploy correlation to reduce noisy suggestions and surface higher-confidence remediation links, 2) slo-toolkit: introduce a new AutodiagHelper module that exposes deterministic sampling for SLO incidents, query templates for common diagnostics (latency percentiles, error counts, tail queue lengths), and telemetry hooks for ranking signals, and 3) oncall helpers: expose a compact context payload and quick-links endpoint consumed by the incident-bot to render actionable runbook suggestions in Slack and the oncall UI. The description includes migration notes for private deployments where runbook storage may be on-premise. This change adds unit and integration tests, updates protocol contracts for the oncall quick-links API, and ships a small telemetry schema change for autodiag signals. Motivation: reduce time-to-remediation by improving signal quality and runbook relevance for SLO-triggered oncall alerts. Rollout plan: feature gated behind incident-bot flag 'autodiag_v2' and slo-toolkit config 'enable_autodiag'; gradual enablement over 2 weeks with canary on staging and 5% traffic on production. See linked linear tasks for rollout checklist.

release_notes: Improved incident-bot runbook linking with SLO-aware heuristics and fingerprinting. Added AutodiagHelper to slo-toolkit for deterministic sampling and diagnostics query templates. Exposed oncall quick-links endpoint for compact context payloads. Feature gated rollout; no immediate breaking changes. Includes telemetry schema v2 with versioning and migration notes.
notes_for_ops: Feature gated; enable autodiag_v2 on a small set of customers first. Observe autodiag_signals_v2 telemetry and dashboards during rollout. For Private installs, ensure runbook storage path is reachable by incident-bot or set incident_bot.runbook_storage to 'local' during migration. If telemetry ingestion shows missing schema v2 events, revert flag and contact infra-team.
changelog_entry: incident-bot: SLO-aware runbook linking and oncall autodiagnostics improvements (feature-gated)
tests_summary: Added 24 new unit tests and 4 integration tests for autodiag heuristics and quick-links API. E2E smoke test added to CI. All tests passing after a flaky e2e rerun.
backwards_compatibility: keeps existing quick-links contract for v1, introduces v2 telemetry with versioning. Default behavior remains v1 until feature flag enabled.
migration_steps: 1. Deploy code with autodiag_v2 disabled. 2. Enable feature flag on staging and run smoke e2e. 3. Enable on 5% production traffic and monitor autodiag_signals_v2 and runbook suggestion rates. 4. If stable after 2 days, increase rollout to 25% then 100%. For Private deployments, follow docs/runbooks/runbook_linking.md to point runbook storage to accessible location.
